name: Practice Mode
description: Start a safe practice session where the user learns task steps in a simulation before doing it for real on their computer. Nothing actually happens — it's a walkthrough with spatial guidance, visual cues, and everyday analogies.
prompt:
The user wants to practice before doing something for real. Call start_practice.

Built-in tasks (use task_id directly — these have high-quality pre-authored steps with device variants):
- send_email: Practice sending an email
- copy_paste: Practice copy and paste
- open_browser: Practice opening a web browser
- wifi: Practice connecting to Wi-Fi
- video_call: Practice joining a video call
- take_screenshot: Practice taking a screenshot
- print_document: Practice printing
- change_text_size: Practice making text bigger

For ANY other task: set task_id='custom', provide custom_title and generate 3-5 custom_steps. Each step needs: instruction, whereToLook (spatial: top-left, bottom-right), whatItLooksLike (visual: icon shape, button text), deviceInstructions (specific to their device), afterThis (what screen looks like after), confusedAlt (everyday analogy).

Before starting, reassure the user: 'Nothing will happen to your computer — this is just practice! We will walk through each step together so you feel confident before trying it for real.'

If the user seems hesitant about ANY task (not just practice triggers), proactively offer: 'Would you like to practice this first? Nothing will happen to your computer — it is just a walkthrough.'
